group.name: Which werewolf setup do you use? (pick one)

plugin.name: Growl user (recommended for Nolvus users)
plugin.description:
Pick this if you use Growl - Werebeasts of Skyrim. Recommended for Nolvus users.
Werewolves get the TWO body and heads. Growl keeps its gameplay. This installs OStim_Beast_Form_Merged.esp and OStim_Beast_Form_Merged_TWO_Patch.esp, the same plugins as Merged 0.6 + the Merged TWO Patch 0.1, so a save that already uses them keeps working.
Needs: Growl, JS Emissive Eyes SE, TWO - Total Werewolf Overhaul 4.1 (Core, with its Growl patch), Monster Facial Animation (MonsterLipSync1.esp).
Growl - Werebeasts of Skyrim: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/31245

plugin.name: TWO user (no Growl)
plugin.description:
Pick this if you use TWO - Total Werewolf Overhaul 4.1 and do NOT use Growl.
This installs OStim_Beast_Form_TWO.esp, the same plugin as OStim Beast Form - TWO Edition 0.2, so a save that already uses it keeps working. Never enable it together with OStim_Beast_Form_Merged.esp.
Needs: TWO 4.1 (Core), Monster Facial Animation (MonsterLipSync1.esp).
TWO - Total Werewolf Overhaul: https://www.loverslab.com/topic/159911-two-total-werewolf-overhaul/
